sample_unit: Google People Also Ask questions about xerostomia

links.outcome: Reading grade level and understandability of ChatGPT xerostomia patient education responses versus online sources
links.effect: ChatGPT mean FKGL 15.24, FRE 30.14, PEMAT 72.33; online sources FKGL 9.87, FRE 51.37, PEMAT 79.92. Both exceeded recommended reading levels.
links.quote: Both online PEM and ChatGPT responses on xerostomia exceeded recommended reading levels, with ChatGPT generating substantially less readable content.

screen.reason: Evaluates the readability and understandability of ChatGPT responses compared to standard online search results for patient queries about xerostomia without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
